summary: <section> element with optional header (title, description, actions), vertical rhythm, and surface.
whenToUse: Thematic blocks of a page: settings, content groups, landing page sections.
whenNotToUse: Standalone, reusable content such as a news item: use Card with as="article".

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title; also provides the accessible name of the region (aria-labelledby).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level, chosen according to the page structure.

props.name: container
props.description: Wraps header and content in a Container: the background spans the full width while the text stays aligned with the page. Omit if the Section is already inside a Container.

inherits: Global HTML attributes; ref to the <section>.
accessibility: With a title, the section becomes a named “region” landmark; without a title or aria-label it remains a plain grouping.
Choose headingLevel based on the actual hierarchy, not the appearance.
responsive: Actions move below the title when there isn’t enough space.
